items.rationale: These are fittings for the insured heating-pipe fracture repair (2.4.3, 7.1.7(c)). Upper customary price is about 7 EUR each.
These are repair fittings under 7.1.7(c). There is some risk of a dimension mismatch with the 15mm pipe (7.1.8(e)). Upper price is about 18 EUR each.
This is a repair fitting under 7.1.7(c), with the same possible dimension issue as line 2.
Fixings for the repaired run are covered under 7.1.7(c), at about 6 EUR each.
Replacement pipe for the insured fracture is covered under 7.1.7(c), at about 12 EUR/m gross.
Labour for the insured repair is covered under 7.1.7(g). The prior gives about 84 EUR/h, so about 566 EUR.
Helper labour is covered under 7.1.7(g), at about 65 EUR/h. This is in line with the Case 18 combined labour level.
Re-insulating the repaired section restores the pre-loss standard (7.1.7(c)). Case 18 showed at least 107 EUR; the prior gives about 146 EUR.
Consumable installation material is covered under 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.8(e).
Lump-sum consumables are expressly not excluded (7.1.8(e)) and are assessed under 7.1.7(c).
This is the first and only travel charge on the invoice, so it is covered under 7.1.7(f). Prior is about 80 EUR.
Debris from the repair is covered under 5.2.1 and 7.1.8(a). Case 18 showed at least 57 EUR.

items.description: Repainting basement hallway outside boiler room
items.rationale: This area was not affected by the water, so it falls outside the repair under 3.5 and 7.1.5 and is maintenance under 7.1.8(a).

items.description: Laminate replacement in undamaged storage room
items.rationale: The room was untouched by the leak. Under 7.1.5 work on unaffected parts is not covered, even when done on the same invoice.
This is maintenance unrelated to the loss (7.1.8(a)).
General administrative and processing charges are excluded under 7.1.8(b).
